formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3); no reinforcing strong anionic. Coco-Glucoside (8) is post-fragrance and not a buffer.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only one prominent buffer; light post-fragrance refatters.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate (bounded): one cationic system Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (10) plus several light routes: Glyceryl Oleate (9), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (15), Lecithin (16), Ascorbyl Palmitate (17), Sodium Hyaluronate (13). C2 not met (no silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Every care route is post-fragrance (guar level typical, but refatters trace); a cleansing-led low reading is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one post-fragrance cationic guar plus weak refatters, facing a buffered SLES chassis; no silicone, lipid, protein or film.

depositionLoad.rationale: Guar (10) and weak refatters (9, 15, 16, 17), all post-fragrance.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light polymer and weak refatters with moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: the only families are one guar and weak_refatter esters (plus a humectant), all after the fragrance marker; no persistent system converges and the SLES chassis offsets light residue.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific (Sodium Hyaluronate 13 and aloe powder 11 are late; humectant cluster too thin for moisture_supported).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 route (all care routes post-fragrance).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

formulaFacts.role: plant juice, not a humectant route
